members.soup_rule: uniform arithmetic mean of every floating-point state_dict tensor over steps 40k/50k/60k/75k WITHIN one seed, never across seeds; non-float buffers and the embedded training config are taken from the 75k checkpoint [machine_fill_in for the buffer/config detail]

scheirer_ft_s42.role: REFERENCE ARM ONLY: never in R1-R4, never a claim base

members.pending_rule: A PENDING-APPROVAL member that is not on disk at selection time is absent: it is dropped from every recipe, and no recipe is redefined to replace it. R2 and R3 are then not evaluable. R4 is evaluated on its on-disk part {soup42, soup43} and is labelled R4-ondisk in every output. If a pending member arrives later, selection is re-run once over the full set BEFORE 252405 is rendered, and both selections are reported.
members.excluded: Hecate 9.6: reported, never in a decision on PHerc0841 (trained on fine-scan predictions where both scans exist; PHerc0841 has both).

inference.input: native 9.366 um volume 20250821151531 rendered along the mesh (c0841-9um.py renderer, mesh path an argument): 9.61 um in plane (4 px of the 2.4 um control grid), 41 layers at 9.6 um about the mesh, trilinear; w00big = build-deciding-test/ours-stack.npy
inference.stack_order: rev: the 21-layer stack reversed along depth before inference (s21[::-1] in c0841-9um.py). Decided from geometry before scoring (2.4 um control read in rev with the same mesh-normal convention; affine det +1). Forward is a control only.
inference.depth_centre_definition: centre c takes layers [mid+c-10, mid+c+10] (21 layers) of the render, mid = layer index of the mesh
inference.member_map: per member: raw model output (no (p-0.25)/0.5 display rescale), mean of the 3 windows per centre, then mean of the 5 centres
inference.tta_rule: mirror TTA = koine infer.py --tta-mirror (mirrors the equal-length in-plane axes of the (17,128,128) input as compute_equal_length_mirror_axes defines; the 17-layer depth axis is never mirrored). Used ONLY in R3. Everything else runs without TTA.
inference.precision: as infer.py does on cuda through polite-run.py; same for every arm

recipes.R1: best single member: among members evaluable at selection time (now: released_s43_75k, soup42, soup43; plus the three MIT community members once on disk; never scheirer_ft_s42), apply the selection rule to single members
recipes.R2: rank-normalised mean of the MIT community members {nieuwlaar_dense_native, klavis_dense, tauil_ft6k}, each with the five-centre depth mean
recipes.R3: R2 with mirror TTA on every member
recipes.R4: rank-normalised mean of R2 members plus soup42 and soup43 (equal weight per member); R4-ondisk = {soup42, soup43} while R2 members are pending
recipes.rank_normalisation: each member map is replaced by (rank within the scoring mask - 0.5) / n, ties averaged; pixels outside the mask are not used

selection.frame: w00big only (995x1245 at 9.61 um, mask = ours-mask & 2.4 render mask, 40 px border excluded, as auc-in-supervision.py). Selection scores are not results.
selection.rule: compute AUC (supervised negatives, HF v2) and hp r at read blur 2 px for every evaluable recipe; keep recipes with AUC >= best AUC - 0.01; select the highest hp r at blur 2.
selection.tie_break: hp r equal to 3 decimals -> fewer members -> lower recipe number [machine_fill_in]
selection.second_arm: the best single member (R1) is frozen as well, whatever is selected (ensembles softened letters by 19-25% in the ckpt-ens run)
selection.freeze: the recipe JSON (selected recipe, R1 member, member files and sha256) is written and hashed before 252405 is rendered

auc.definition: Mann-Whitney AUC on the scoring grid; positives = pixels with pooled ink-label fraction >= 0.75; negatives = pooled ink-label fraction <= 0 AND pooled supervision fraction >= 0.75; inside the render/model mask with a 40 px border excluded
auc.labels_primary: HF v2 (inklabels_v2, supervision_mask_v2), the set the 0.731 / 0.762 w00big baselines used
auc.labels_secondary: S3 ink-labels 20260918 (reviewed set), reported, never decisive

hp_r.definition: Scheirer hp_score.py (ShribyrLabs/vesuvius-reports commit d4e7b78, 02-9um-ink-reader-benchmark/scripts/hp_score.py): Pearson r between read and key after both are high-passed by normalised convolution, hp(x) = x - G(x*m)/max(G(m), 1e-3), Gaussian sigma = 48.0 um / grid pitch (4.995 px at 9.61 um); scored on core = valid & G(valid, 2 sigma) > 0.999 and read > 0
hp_r.key: ScrollPrize 2.4 um map, model 20260417190342, full-resolution tif area-averaged onto the scoring grid (w00: sha256 c980b60dc457037d0cfe8c654619c23f3fd673e2847d64aed09cbdb3e26f7bde; 252405: sha256 11d40335c8c7c0afa87a15cd82cb407d2bfdbf6ccb2117b12b2e313678a24709). The earlier w00big run used the ds8 jpg; selection uses the tif.
hp_r.blur_rule: Gaussian blur of the READ only, before the high-pass; the key is never blurred; arms compare only at equal blur
hp_r.null: 48 shifted keys: (dy, dx) in {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3} mm squared minus (0,0), 1 mm = 104 px at 9.61 um, overlap only (no wrap), as SHIFTS in c0841-9um.py; report mean and max; a read clears the null when its zero-shift hp r > the null max
